x-changelog.description: The response of Bid Board project endpoints now includes new fields: estimator_user_id, office_id, customer_company and updated_at.

x-changelog.description: The response of Bid Board project endpoints now includes project_id: the Procore Portfolio project identifier linked to this Bid Board project.

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"name\":\"string\",\"as_template\":true}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/estimating/bid_board_projects/%7Bbid_board_project_id%7D/clone", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
